subject: [PATCH] mm/memory-tiers: reset demotion targets of nodes without memory

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Agreed with Zi Yan's suggestion to add a comment explaining the use of for_each_node() instead of for_each_node_state(N_MEMORY). Also gave an LGTM (Looks Good To Me) verdict.

2026-10-20.patch_summary: The patch addresses a memory management issue in the Linux kernel's memory-tiers code, where nodes without memory were not having their demotion targets reset properly. This led to stale entries being used by reclaimers between node regaining memory and its targets being rebuilt. The patch resets the targets of every node, fixing this issue.
